confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, pypdf fallback extraction, rendered figure/methods pages, and the downloaded supplement DOC/text extraction were checked. Exp. 3 is separable from the other Serino 2015 experiments: it uses the two-speaker hand-centered setup, five distances, 22 cm/s motion, hand dorsum vibration, reported trial families, D1/D5 baselines, 500-700 ms ITI jitter, 16 repetitions, and 208 total trials. Remaining uncertainty concerns exact original sound files, exact audio duration/SOA milliseconds, hand side, block/order rules, response timeout, and exact catch-direction composition.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: Experiment 3 can be recreated as a lateralized peri-hand looming/receding pink-noise task using the reported two-speaker near/far geometry, 22 cm/s motion, D1-D5 distance table, hand-dorsum vibrotactile target, D1/D5 tactile-only baselines, sound-only catches, and 208-trial formula. Exact original WAV/envelope files and some order/response details remain approximations.

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Participant body/gaze direction is not explicitly specified; the hand was placed at shoulder width and therefore lateralized rather than on the midline.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Two facing loudspeakers formed a 1 m near-far line, with the near speaker about 5 cm from the hand and the far speaker about 100 cm away.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: Authors map sounds as moving toward or away from the participant's hand; D1-D5 are hand-relative distances from nearest to farthest.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Single vibrotactor delivered 100 ms tactile stimulation to the hand dorsum; the exact hand side is not stated for Exp. 3.
orientation_ledger.movement_implementation: Two physical loudspeakers were coactivated with differential intensity to create apparent continuous looming/receding motion.
orientation_ledger.evidence_class: Text-reported in main PDF methods/results and supplement, with Figure 1/caption visually confirming the two-speaker near/far layout.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 3-4 for Experiment 3 and Figure 1; pages 11-13 for tactile apparatus, acoustic stimuli, procedure, design, counts, table, and ITI.
Used as primary extracted text map for targeted five-pass searches, then checked against rendered pages and fallback extraction.
Visual inspection of Figure 1 upper-left panel for the 2-speaker near/far layout used in Experiments 1, 3, 4, and 5.
Checked the two-speaker setup, loudspeaker model, pink-noise provenance, SoundForge shaping, dB endpoints, and validation section.
Searched for hand, dorsum, two-speaker, M-Audio, pink-noise, SoundForge, SPL, looming, receding, and validation terms.
Printed targeted snippets from pages 3, 11, 12, and 13 to verify Exp. 3 separation from the other six experiments.
Temporary rendered pages checked for visual geometry, methods wording, and design/count paragraphs; page images were not committed.

review_attempts.result: Mapped 20/25 auto-mined candidate fields and exposed cross-experiment contamination from Exp. 1/2 speeds and counts.
Isolated Exp. 3 as the peri-hand task: two-speaker setup, lateralized hand at shoulder width, D1-D5 distances, and 22 cm/s apparent motion.
Rendered and inspected Figure 1/methods pages; recorded hand-centered near/far geometry and the missing hand-side/gaze details in the orientation ledger.
pypdf snippets confirmed the Experiment 3 distances, shoulder-width hand posture, two-speaker apparatus, tactile-dorsum placement, count formula, and ITI.
Supplement supplied M-Audio speakers, 1 m separation, pink-noise 44.1 kHz samples, SoundForge 4.5, and 55-70 dB exponential envelopes for the shared two-speaker setup.

review_attempts.strategy: Trial sequence, baseline, catch, and count pass
review_attempts.result: Identified three trial families, D1/D5 tactile-only baselines, sound-only catches, 16 repetitions, 208 total trials, and derived 32 baseline plus 16 catch trials.
Checked the paper's references to Canzoneri et al. 2012 and the supplement; kept exact WAV/envelope files, hand side, block/order rules, and response timeout as unresolved.

stimulus_type.value: Pink-noise auditory samples at 44.1 kHz in the shared two-speaker setup.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The supplement describes the two-speaker setup used in Experiments 1, 3, 4, and 5.

source_provenance.value: SoundForge 4.5 shaped pink-noise samples; exact source WAV/noise seed is not reported.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Software/source class is reported, but not the actual stimulus file.

trajectory_count.value: Two hand-centered auditory motion directions: looming toward the hand and receding away from the hand.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Experiment 3 ANOVA crossed Sound Direction Looming vs Receding with five distances.

trajectory_path.value: Near-far line from about 5 to 100 cm relative to the lateralized hand; sampled D1-D5 values were 5, 27, 50, 71, and 93 cm.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Experiment 3 and Figure 1; p.11 Acoustic Stimuli
trajectory_path.evidence_note: The hand was at shoulder width and not on the midline; Figure 1 provides the shared 2-speaker near/far geometry.

stimulus_duration.value: Full apparent-motion path duration is about 4.55 s for a 100 cm near-far distance at 22 cm/s.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Derived from reported path distance and speed; no separate Exp. 3 audio-file duration is printed.

stimulus_speed.evidence_note: This separates Exp. 3 from the faster 16-speaker Exp. 2 and slower Exp. 6 values.

auditory_conditions.value: Looming and receding moving sounds were tested around the hand.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Both directions affected tactile processing, with stronger looming effects.

gain_envelope.value: Looming intensity rose exponentially from 55 to 70 dB SPL; receding decreased exponentially from 70 to 55 dB SPL.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: The near/far speakers were coactivated with opposing intensity patterns.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two M-Audio Studiophile AV 360 loudspeakers facing each other, one near and one far, coactivated with differential intensity.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The main PDF says the two-speaker setup was used in Exp. 3; the supplement gives speaker model and placement.

trial_rows_families.value: Three trial families: bimodal audio-tactile trials, tactile-only baseline trials, and auditory-only catch/no-go trials.
trial_rows_families.page_or_section: PDF p.12, General Procedure and Design and Analysis
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The design section lists the broad trial types used across experiments.

condition_intermixing.value: Exp. 3 rows appear combined in a single 208-trial task formula with five distances and two sound directions; no separate blocked phases are described.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Derived from the combined formula; exact order/randomization algorithm is not reported.

blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: No explicit block count, block structure, or trial randomization algorithm was found.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Inter-trial intervals were randomly shuffled between 500 and 700 ms.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: Reported as a general rule after the experiment-specific trial-count formulas.

response_window.evidence_note: XBOX button response is reported, but no explicit response timeout/window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants responded rapidly to tactile hand vibration, treated sounds as task-irrelevant, and withheld responses on sound-only catches.
task_sequence_rules.page_or_section: PDF p.12, General Procedure and Design and Analysis
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The general procedure states the response and catch rules.

tactile_stimulus.value: Single Precision MicroDrives 312-101 150 Hz vibration motor on hand dorsum; stimulation lasted 100 ms.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Methods also report 3 V, 60 mA, 9000 rpm, 5 g, 113 mm2 surface area, and 50 ms spin-up.

soa_table.value: Five distance-at-touch values D1-D5: 5, 27, 50, 71, and 93 cm; temporal offsets follow 22 cm/s motion and reverse for looming/receding.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF p.3, Experiment 3; p.11 Acoustic Stimuli
soa_table.evidence_note: Exact SOA milliseconds are not separately printed, but the distance table and speed are reported.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only unimodal baseline trials without sound; fastest baseline condition was subtracted from audio-tactile RTs.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline correction strategy is explicitly described for all experiments.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline trials used two temporal delays corresponding to D1 and D5, the nearest and farthest Exp. 3 sampled distances.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: The formula lists baselines D1 and D5; exact millisecond values are not tabulated.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only catch trials: sound presented without tactile stimulation, with response withholding required.
catch_trial_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.12-13, Design and Analysis and Table 1
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Table 1 reports Exp. 3 catch accuracy; the formula includes catch trials.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Exp. 3 formula: [D1-D5 multisensory x 2 directions + D1/D5 baselines + catch trials] x 16 repetitions.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Thus each distance x sound-direction cell has 16 repetitions.

baseline_count.value: Two baseline rows x 16 repetitions = 32 tactile-only baseline trials.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Derived directly from the D1/D5 baseline rows and repetition factor.

catch_count.value: Total 208 minus 160 multisensory minus 32 baseline trials leaves 16 auditory-only catch trials.
catch_count.page_or_section: PDF p.13, Design and Analysis; Table 1
catch_count.evidence_note: The formula includes catch trials but does not split catch trials by sound direction.

block_count.evidence_note: The paper says experiments never exceeded 60 minutes, but no Exp. 3 block/session count was found.

total_trial_count.evidence_note: The total is explicitly reported with the Exp. 3 formula.

critical_caveats: Exact original pink-noise WAV/noise seed is not reported.
Exact SoundForge envelope files are not provided beyond exponential direction and dB endpoints.
Auditory file duration and SOA milliseconds are derived from reported path length/speed rather than printed as a table.
Exact hand side is not stated for Exp. 3, though the hand is reported as shoulder-width and lateralized.
Exact trial-order randomization, block count, and response timeout/window are not reported.
Catch count is derived from the formula residual and total; catch split by looming/receding direction is not explicitly reported.
next_manual_action: Strong candidate for a runnable lateralized peri-hand two-speaker/digital two-source profile, with original WAV/envelope files, hand side, exact SOA milliseconds, catch-direction split, and block/order rules treated as approximations unless author materials become available.
